verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service that collects sensitive founder and company data, so whether users can opt out of AI-model training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-usage opt-outs, or related privacy controls; the docs cover incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filings, banking and perks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
